title: Equity price file misses its window
brief: You picked up the shift twelve minutes ago. Pricing is flagging stale marks, risk has thrown a limit breach on EQ_STAT_ARB, and P&L is showing a 6-sigma move that nobody on the desk believes. The open is in two hours and eighteen minutes.

checks.label: Check whether the vendor price file landed
Read the price loader logs
Drill into the P&L spike
Check the vendor's status page and open a ticket
Investigate the risk limit breach
Check whether the secondary price source is usable

impacts.headline: Risk is re-firing
impacts.detail: The false breach re-fires every cycle and is training the desk to ignore risk alerts.

impacts.headline: PMs are looking at bad marks
impacts.detail: Two portfolio managers have opened the blotter. Nobody has told them the marks are yesterday's.

impacts.headline: Pre-open checks will fail
impacts.detail: Without current marks the pre-open risk run cannot complete, and the desk opens blind.

required.label: Tell the PMs the marks are stale
Open a ticket with the vendor

title: Everything fails at once
brief: Eight services went red inside four seconds. Trade capture, positions, pricing, risk, the blotter, recon, the OMS and reporting are all erroring. Three portfolio managers are already asking what is going on. The market is open and they are trading.

checks.label: Check database connection pool utilisation
Order the failures by first error timestamp
Look at what the failing services have in common
Restart the OMS
Pull the slow query log
Kill the offending session

impacts.headline: Blotter is diverging
impacts.detail: Fills are arriving but not being captured. What PMs see is already wrong.

impacts.headline: PMs are trading on a stale book
impacts.detail: Position keeping is behind. Anyone sizing off the blotter is sizing off a book that is minutes old and getting older.

impacts.headline: Risk is not evaluating
impacts.detail: Pre-trade risk checks are failing open or failing closed depending on the strategy. Neither is acceptable during the session.

required.label: Tell the PMs the book is unreliable

title: Broker A goes quiet
brief: The FIX session to executing broker A has stopped acknowledging. Orders are rejecting, the drop copy has gone silent, and one portfolio manager says a fill he watched execute is not on his blotter. He is mid-programme and wants to know whether to keep going.

checks.label: Check the FIX session state and sequence numbers
Compare the drop copy against the OMS
Call the broker's trading desk
Check exchange connectivity
Reroute the working programme to broker B
Reconstruct true position from execution reports

impacts.headline: The PM is flying blind
impacts.detail: He is watching a blotter that is missing fills and deciding whether to keep working the order.

impacts.headline: Unconfirmed messages are ageing
impacts.detail: Forty-five unacknowledged messages. Every minute makes the resend and the reconciliation messier.

impacts.headline: Risk of double execution
impacts.detail: If the PM re-enters what he thinks is missing and the original fills confirm, the position doubles.

required.label: Give the PM his true position
Escalate to the broker for a resend

title: A P&L spike that is not real
brief: P&L is showing an 8-sigma move on FX_CARRY and a 4-sigma on MULTI_ASSET. Nothing in the overnight news supports it. The head of the FX strategy has already messaged asking whether he lost money overnight.

checks.label: Check the age of the FX rates in use
Attribute the P&L move
Verify positions are correct
Check the FX vendor connection
Check the FX consumer's offset
Check whether equity marks are also stale

impacts.headline: A PM believes he lost money
impacts.detail: The FX strategy head is acting on a number that is an artefact.

impacts.headline: Risk is sizing off bad rates
impacts.detail: Overnight risk limits for non-USD books are evaluated against yesterday's rates.

impacts.headline: The official P&L run will use the bad rates
impacts.detail: If this is not fixed before the EOD run, a wrong P&L goes out to investors and has to be restated.

required.label: Tell the FX PM the move is an artefact
Escalate the parse failure to engineering

title: Two problems, one window
brief: The locate file from the prime brokers has not loaded, and in the same twenty minutes broker B has started rejecting orders. It is tempting to assume these are related. The short book needs locates before the open.

checks.label: Check the locate file load
Check the broker B reject reason
Check whether the two share any dependency
Work out short coverage against the intended book
Call the prime brokers for the missing files
Source single-name locates for the gap

impacts.headline: Short orders will fail pre-trade checks
impacts.detail: Uncovered names will be blocked at the open, and the strategy will run half-dressed.

impacts.headline: Reg SHO exposure
impacts.detail: If an uncovered short reaches the market the firm has a compliance problem, not just a trading one.

impacts.headline: Broker B still rejecting
impacts.detail: Working the locate problem alone means the second incident has gone unworked for half an hour.

required.label: Treat these as two separate incidents
Tell the PMs which names are uncovered
